stories.title: Luis scores 11 in LSU debut; Wade says, 'Everyone we played tonight was eligible'
stories.summary: RJ Luis Jr. came off the bench and played 15 minutes in Wednesday night's game against UL Monroe, a move that promises to intensify the showdown between the university and SEC.

stories.title: Giannis, Bam put Bucks drama aside, 'on to the next thing' after Heat win
stories.summary: Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo said Wednesday night's win over the Bucks was like any other night, while Bam Adebayo said he has moved past his issues with Tyler Herro.

stories.title: Georgia AG encourages SEC to take 'action' vs. LSU, 'including expulsion'
stories.summary: The Georgia Attorney General blasted LSU in a letter to SEC commissioner Greg Sankey, encouraging sanctions against the Tigers, "up to and including expulsion."

stories.title: Redick cites fatigue as Luka's shot goes cold, Lakers' win streak ends at 9
stories.summary: Luka Doncic said his performance in Wednesday's loss to Utah, in which he shot 10-of-28 and had nine turnovers, was "unacceptable" as the Lakers' win streak ended at nine.

stories.title: 'I love the clutch': 76ers rally, improve to 11-0 in tight games
stories.summary: The 76ers improved to 11-0 in clutch games after overcoming a 17-point deficit to beat the Magic on Wednesday night.
